crossRefs.note: “ ‘ “The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and…
Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

people.name: Dedan
people.line: An Arabian people and region, involved in trade.

translations.web: “ ‘ “Dedan was your trafficker in precious cloths for riding.
translations.bsb: Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.
translations.kjv: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
translations.asv: Dedan was thy trafficker in precious cloths for riding.
